name: bodytype-algorithm-v2-test-vectors
description: Synthetic test vectors for the Bodytype v2 classification rule set. No user measurements are included.

fields.label: Expected Bodytype label id.
fields.stability_radius_cm: Single-field stability radius in centimetres (0 = on a boundary).
fields.reachable_labels: Semicolon-separated reachable label ids at the radius; empty if none.
